name: azure-foundry
description: Design and architect AI agents on Azure AI Foundry -- lifecycle planning, model selection strategy, evaluation frameworks, guardrail design, and deployment patterns. Use when designing agent architecture on Foundry, choosing models, planning evaluation strategy, or defining guardrails. For step-by-step operational workflows (create, deploy, invoke, trace, troubleshoot), install the Azure MCP Extension (ms-azuretools.vscode-azure-mcp-server), which also brings in the Azure Skills plugin and Foundry MCP support in VS Code.
